WITH counts_per_side AS (
  SELECT 
    o.dealedge,
    COUNT(*) as side_count
  FROM riskandmargin rm
  INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(side_count) as avg_count FROM counts_per_side
),
above_avg_sides AS (
  SELECT 
    cps.side_count,
    ac.avg_count,
    cps.side_count - ac.avg_count as excess
  FROM counts_per_side cps
  CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac
  WHERE cps.side_count > ac.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(side_count) as total_count,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg_sides
